title: Southbridge Miniwave runbook and release draft
content:
Purpose: quick, low-risk micro-rollout for the Southbridge feature set (routing refinements + KV cache tweak). This doc is the working runbook, checklist, and release notes draft for the 72-hour miniwave. Keep it short, actionable.

High-level goals:
- Deploy routing and cache change with <5% error surface increase, <50ms p95 latency regression, and automated rollback on error or high-error-rate.
- Validate model routing behavior with synthetic traffic and small canary cohorts.
- Capture precise telemetry for post-rollout review.

Open questions / decisions to make:
- Should we enable the cache opt-in for Dedicated customers in the same wave? (prefer NO unless SRE signoff)
- Toggle naming: use sb-202610-miniwave-1 for rollout tag? (propose yes)

Preflight checklist (Day -3 to -1):
- [ ] Finalize PR and get one approving review (PR #RE-2453).
- [ ] Ensure canary config has 2x health check frequency for the first hour.
- [ ] Add feature-flag with default OFF for all prod routes. Flag: feature/southbridge-miniwave-2026-10.
- [ ] Smoke test harness created and stored in /playbooks/southbridge/smoke-2026-10 (link in Jira).
- [ ] Nightly load run against staging for 4 hours with KV sizes matching production 95th percentile. Record CPU/GPU and mem metrics.
- [ ] Observability: Dashboards copied and annotated: latency p50/p95/p99, error rate, CPU/GPU, cache hit ratio, KV eviction rate, routing mismatch rate. Confirm alert thresholds.
- [ ] SLO guardrails: set temporary high-priority alerts (pager) for error rate >0.7% sustained 5m or p95 latency +25% vs baseline 15m baseline window.
- [ ] Confirm rollback artifact builds are available and verified (image tag: sb-rollback-20261002).
- [ ] Notify customer-success for any upcoming dedicated customer traffic windows in the next 7 days.

Cutover plan (Day 0 — rollout window):
T-02:00: final quick sync (eng, sres, oncall, product) in #deploy-southbridge. Read the checklist out loud.
T-01:30: flip health-check cadence for canary (2m -> 1m).
T-01:00: Create release tag: sb-miniwave-2026-10-01. Capture git sha and build id in the release note header.
T+00:00: Enable feature flag for 1% of requests (cohort selected by random hashing, region-aware). Watch for: error rate, latency p95, model routing mismatch (new vs old).
T+00:10: If metrics stable, move to 5% after approval via Slack ephemeral signoff (deploy lead).
T+00:30: If stable, 20% for 1 hour. Begin synthetic traffic validation from canary harness targeted at problematic payload shapes (long sequences).
T+02:00: If stable, 50% for 2 hours. Confirm no error regression and cache hit ratio trending up.
T+04:00: Full rollout (100%) unless any blocking signals.

Immediate rollback conditions:
- Any sustained error rate >1.5% for 10m.
- p95 latency regression >50% vs baseline for 15m.
- Any critical customer-impacting alerts (SLA breach) triggered.
- Model routing mismatch >2% of logged requests (indicating incorrect fallback logic).
Rollback steps (fast):
1) Toggle feature flag OFF.
2) If feature flag toggle does not clear, revert traffic routing to previous backing variant via traffic router console.
3) If code-level issues suspected, roll back to image sb-rollback-20261002 (tagged).
4) Open incident channel and start postmortem doc with initial timeline.

Observability and playbook snippets:
- Dashboards: /dashboards/ops/southbridge-miniwave-2026-10 (make a copy).
- Recommended query for error-rate (pager trigger): sum(rate(http_request_errors[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests[1m])) * 100 > 0.7
- KV cache health: cache_hit_ratio = cache_hits / (cache_hits + cache_misses). Expect > 70% on 50% rollout within 2 hours.
- Routing mismatch check (LogQL query): count_over_time({app="routing"} |= "mismatch" [5m]) / count_over_time({app="routing"} [5m]) > 0.02 -> investigate.

Day-by-day rollout calendar (compact):
Day -3 (2026-10-01): finish PR review, run staging soak, prepare dashboards.
Day -2 (2026-10-02): final triage of flaky tests, sanity check rollback artifacts, update runbook.
Day -1 (2026-10-03): tabletop 30m, block traffic blackout windows with CS, freeze merges for the service.
Day 0 (2026-10-04): rollout per cutover plan above (start 09:00 PT).
Day +1 (2026-10-05): monitor 24h, collect telemetry, run quick user-facing smoke tests, compile early rollback notes if any.
Day +2 (2026-10-06): retrospective + telemetry deep-dive (team + product + SRE). Draft release notes and change log.

Release notes (draft) — short version:
Title: Southbridge miniwave — improved routing and KV cache behavior (2026-10-04)
Summary: Small, incremental update to routing heuristics and KV cache tuning to reduce average token generation cost and improve tail latency on long-sequence requests. Deployed as a controlled miniwave (feature flag).
What changed:
- Routing: new heuristic to prefer low-latency regional replicas for short sequences; smoother fallbacks for overloaded replicas.
- KV cache: adjusted eviction threshold to keep more prefixes for frequent users; quality safety net to prevent cache poisoning.
- Telemetry: added routing_mismatch counter and cache_hit_ratio metric.
Why this matters:
- Expected ~8–12% reduction in p95 latency for typical long-seq workloads and 4–6% reduction in token compute for some high-reuse prefixes.
Rollout notes:
- Rollout done as a staged canary over 8 hours with automated guardrail checks. No customer-facing downtime.
Known issues / caveats:
- In internal stress tests, very rare (<<0.1%) mismatch event observed under synthetic churn; we will keep an eye for first 48h.
- Dedicated customers with custom routing overrides need to be onboarded separately — kept OFF by default.
\TODO:
- Finalize customer-facing KB article for CS. (owner: Sofia)
- Add example telemetry panels to the product dashboard (owner: Marcus)
- Run additional A/B on reroute thresholds in one-week experiment (owner: Diego)

Post-mortem template (pre-seeded) — quick copy to incident doc if rollback occurs:
- Timeline: auto-populate via deploy tag; record T0, T+10m, T+30m markers.
- Signals observed: error-rate, latency, cache hit, routing mismatch.
- Immediate remediation steps taken.
- RCA owner + action items + due dates.

Checklist for the morning after (Day +1):
- [ ] Export 24h traces for sample of routed requests (top 500 by latency).
- [ ] Confirm cache hit ratio over time (plot every 30m).
- [ ] Customer-impact scan: cross-reference top 10 customers by volume for anomalies.
- [ ] Merge telemetry improvements back to main dashboards and tag as permanent.

Notes to self (choppy):
- Keep rollout conservative. If in doubt, delay step (e.g., 20% -> wait extra hour).
- Avoid cascading deploys: do not deploy unrelated services in the same window.
- Keep a named person (deploy owner) in the thread who can flip the flag.

Appendix: quick links and artifacts
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/service-routing/pull/781 (internal)
- Canary harness: internal://playbooks/southbridge/harness-2026-10 (link pinned in Jira)
- Rollback image: registry.redwood/southbridge:sb-rollback-20261002
- Slack channel: #deploy-southbridge (pinned messages for steps)

End notes: this is a working draft. Add your field notes below — timestamped. Keep the doc light.

Field notes: (10/04 09:00 Marcus) canary started at 09:00 PT, 1% -> 5% after 14m, metrics nominal.
